sections.title: Short turns, learned as blocks
sections.content: At a stall the seller speaks in short chunks. *Tessék!* means "Here you are" when something is handed to you. *Mást?* and *Még valamit?* both ask "Anything else?". You answer with the next item, or close with *Ennyi.* ("That's all."). Learn these as blocks, as you learned *Mennyibe kerül?*. At a friend's stall you stay with *kérsz*, as with any friend.

items.english: No, that's all. How much is it in total?

sections.content: *Viszontlátásra* is the full form of the *viszlát* you know, a little more polite. Among friends, *Szia!* is just as good. *Tessék* is said by the person who hands something over, and the other person answers *Köszönöm*.
